newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares hit all-time closing high yet again.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares hit all-time closing high yet again.

text.p: Danish share prices closed at a new all-time end-of-day record high for the seventh consecutive trading day on Tuesday with dealers optimistic about the prospects for further advances.
"Major purchasing orders stalled off any possible falls. If all goes well in the United States tonight, we'll see more gains tomorrow," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index closed 0.90 point higher at 126.25 in overall bourse turnover of 836 million crowns. The KFX December future fell 0.25 point to 125.75 with 10 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Assisted by bond market advances, Unibank rose six crowns to close at 284, outdoing rival Den Danske Bank, which ended only four higher at 434.
SAS Denmark was one of the busiest papers with 266,000 shares changing hands to finish one crown up 70.
Copenhagen Airports also helped pull the index up, finishing an impressive 17 crowns ahead at 632.
